rules.sentence: Note that a high degree of pleomorphism should classify any tumor as an undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma.
Fibrosarcomas are soft tissue sarcoma spindle cells characterized by fusiform oval nuclei, lance-shaped tapered cells, and unipolar or bipolar cytoplasm.
Adult fibrosarcomas show a mild to moderate degree of pleomorphism.
Neoplastic cells are arranged in long sweeping fascicles that form a classic "herringbone" pattern.
Fibrosarcomas display varying degrees of mitotic activity and have darkly staining nuclei with prominent nucleoli and scant cytoplasm (see Images.
Note that a high degree of pleomorphism should classify any tumor as an undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma.
